import json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
items=['/var/backups/lowcost-europa','/var/lib/lowcost-europa','/run/lowcost-europa','/run/pink-vpn','/var/lib/pink-vpn','/etc/pink-vpn','/etc/iptvpn-bot','/var/log/lowcost-europa','/var/log/pink-iptv','/var/log/fadego','/root/project-secrets','/root/project-secrets/lowcost-europa','/srv/projects/lowcost-europa/backups','/srv/projects/lowcost-europa/data','/etc/systemd/system/lowcost-europa-backup.service','/etc/systemd/system/lowcost-europa-offsite-backup.service','/etc/systemd/system/project-secrets-offsite-backup.service']
r={'locations':{},'timers':[]}
for name in items:
 p=Path(name)
 val='symlink' if p.is_symlink() else 'directory' if p.is_dir() else 'file' if p.is_file() else 'absent'
 row={'kind':val,'target':str(p.resolve(strict=False)) if val=='symlink' else None}
 if val=='directory':
  row['children_count']=len(list(p.iterdir())) if len(list(p.iterdir()))<500 else 'many'
 r['locations'][name]=row
p=subprocess.run(['systemctl','list-timers','--all','--no-pager','--no-legend'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
r['timers']=[x.split()[-1] for x in p.stdout.splitlines() if any(y in x.lower() for y in ('lowcost','pink','fadego','project-secrets'))][:35]
print(json.dumps(r,separators=(',',':')))
